summary: Frontend-only retest completed on public URL. Full 6/6 flows passed for Software Developer and Nurse on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844), all-5 career regression/content checks passed, but desktop mouse drag interactions on Step 1 and desktop tradeoff persistence (pair 2/3 checkpoint) still fail.

ui_bugs.issue: Actual desktop mouse drag failed repeatedly: bank→activity and activity→activity did not allocate/move tokens in focused retest.

integration_issues.issue: After answering tradeoff pair 3 and reloading, flow resumed at 'Little choice 3 of 4' instead of expected '4 of 4' in repeat desktop check.

action_items: Fix desktop DnD reliability in EnergyWorkday for bank→activity and activity→activity token movement under sticky layout.
Fix tradeoff checkpoint persistence around pair-3 answer + reload so resume index is deterministic (should be pair 4 when pair 1-3 are answered).
Re-run focused desktop retest for the two failing flows after fix (keep mobile regression run as safety).
critical_code_review_comments: EnergyWorkday DnD works for tap/+ paths but physical desktop drag path is still non-deterministic in live browser tests.
Session sanitization/reset behavior for malformed JSON, invalid IDs, and outdated payloads is correctly defensive (resets safely).
Results route guard generally works in clean and completion-state rechecks (/results redirected to /reality-check).
careerContent.js, careersDb.js, and App.css remained unchanged from /tmp/careerpeek-flow-before snapshots (hash/diff matched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/iteration7_frontend_retest_log.md for exact executed runs and counts. Strong passes: full 6/6 completion on desktop+mobile for Software Developer and Nurse; all-5 career regression/content uniqueness checks; malformed/outdated payload safety; mobile touch drag and touch slider interactions; disabled results behavior. Remaining blockers are specifically desktop Step-1 physical drag reliability and desktop tradeoff checkpoint persistence at pair 2/3 reload checkpoint.
rca of the issue: Desktop drag RCA repro: open /careers/software-developer/reality-check -> Begin -> place 5 tokens -> remove one -> drag a bank token to activity card; expected target count increment, actual count unchanged. Also drag activity token to another activity often no-op. Likely cause area: dnd-kit pointer collision/over target resolution with sticky token bank/footer and card drop surfaces. Tradeoff persistence RCA repro: answer pair1, pair2, pair3 -> reload immediately after pair3 selection; expected progress 'Little choice 4 of 4', actual 'Little choice 3 of 4' indicates pair3 answer not consistently persisted before reload or not read back consistently. Mitigation: add deterministic persistence confirmation after selection (or ensure update/write session path always commits before navigation/reload-sensitive transitions) and add automated regression for pair3 checkpoint reload. No APIs are MOCKED; app is static frontend flow as requested.
